About

Soumik is a Ph.D. student working with Dr. Shahid at Southern Illinois University Carbondale. His work connects trustworthy AI and social computing, examining privacy and security in generative models and consumer platforms.

Education

  • BS in Computer Science and Engineering, Rajshahi University of Engineering and Technology

Professional Experience

His research experience includes SHIELD Lab (June 2025–July 2026) and human–agent interaction work at CVEX/The Arch from August 2026. Earlier, he worked on SAR imagery and land-cover fusion at the Center for Computational and Data Sciences, Independent University, Bangladesh (January 2022–June 2023).

Teaching

His SIUC graduate teaching experience includes algorithms, networks, operating systems, and Computer Concepts and AI. He previously assisted with programming and data structures at Independent University, Bangladesh.

Research Interests

Trustworthy AI, privacy-preserving machine learning, generative-AI forensics, misinformation, human–AI interaction and emerging quantum machine learning.
